reason: C++ render and FrameGraph sources form the native target. Offline DXC outputs are independent runtime files loaded at startup, so their same-binary update, rejection and rollback behavior is tested separately.
host_contract: Windows x86_64 next_visual_client owns native D3D12 queues, fences and descriptors. Offline DXC shader outputs accompany the exact target and are bound by VisualBuildReport/VisualPackage digests. Headless targets retain their separate dependency contract.
rollback: Restore source and shader inputs, rebuild the visual target and its shader bundle, verify original rendered pixels and native identity. Existing headless runtime output remains independently built.
